description:
Detects sequential or predictable resource ID access patterns indicating IDOR vulnerability exploitation

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg04_013", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%insecure%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%direct%') AND "value" > 0
